top_missions.title: Enforce Single-Writer Lock on Dialer leads_database.json
top_missions.problem_statement: Historical ad-hoc scripts caused dataset shrinkage (762 -> 702) by writing directly without locking.
top_missions.recommended_fix: Route all dialer mutations through DialerSingleWriter gateway with dataset shrinkage exception.

top_missions.title: Dual-Engine Calling Cockpit & Sub-Second Objection Routing
top_missions.problem_statement: Dialer needed dedicated lanes for Real Estate Sellers vs AI Business Buyers with 12 objection playbooks.
top_missions.recommended_fix: Implement tabbed cockpit, live identity audit, and 12-category interactive objection matrix.

top_missions.title: GTM Commander 100+ Daily Real Leads Permanent Historical Dedupe
top_missions.problem_statement: Old systems recycled stale leads. Daily factory needs genuine verified rows with immutable ledger.
top_missions.recommended_fix: Maintain SQLite-backed exclusion ledger rejecting any phone or entity seen in prior batches.

top_missions.title: Strict Revenue Attribution: Confirmed Revenue vs Pipeline Separation
top_missions.problem_statement: Never mix pipeline value, expected value, and confirmed revenue in executive reporting.
top_missions.recommended_fix: Strictly enforce three-tier financial schema across all GTM centers and Telegram notifications.

top_missions.title: Canonical Neteller Monorepo Rail & Link Verification
top_missions.problem_statement: Stripe deprecation required single canonical payout rail (Neteller 4599228811) on all checkout surfaces.
top_missions.recommended_fix: Validate Neteller link generation and fallback in Python, Node, and React frontends.

top_missions.title: Live Owner Identity Transition & Caller Audit Gates
top_missions.problem_statement: Database owner verified != live caller identity confirmed. Suppressed callers (tenant, wrong number) must be gated.
top_missions.recommended_fix: Enforce 3-point live confirmation before OWNER_CONFIRMED status and quarantine non-owners.

top_missions.title: Executive 15-Minute Discovery Meeting Brief Automated Pipeline
top_missions.problem_statement: When meetings are booked, closing team needs instant 15-min discovery agenda and ROI dossier.
top_missions.recommended_fix: Automate structured meeting brief generation in JSON and Markdown with instant Telegram notification.

top_missions.title: Telegram Executive Brief Zero-Noise Enforcement
top_missions.problem_statement: Telegram brief was cluttered with CPU/RAM/process/git telemetry instead of money & progress.
top_missions.recommended_fix: Purge all technical telemetry from Telegram bus; restrict to revenue, meetings, warmed leads, and next actions.

top_missions.title: Automated Test Suite Hardening & 100% Pass Invariant
top_missions.problem_statement: Ensure continuous regression safety across all 200+ unit, acceptance, and integration tests.
top_missions.recommended_fix: Maintain hermetic test fixtures and run full regression suite before every commit.

top_missions.title: MBM-Social Multi-Brand Autonomous Content & Signal Ingestion
top_missions.problem_statement: Social content must extract viral engagement signals and hand off qualified buyer prospects to GTM.
top_missions.recommended_fix: Connect MBM-Social engagement analytics with LeadEngine intent scoring pipeline.

top_missions.title: 12-Niche OfferArchitect Dynamic Packaging Engine
top_missions.problem_statement: Generic sales pitches produce low conversions. Each verified niche needs tailored ROI packages.
top_missions.recommended_fix: Map 12 business verticals to specific AI agents (Estimating, Voice Receptionist, Intake, Recall).

top_missions.problem_statement: Avoid rigid scripts; dynamic conversation brain must choose best next question based on prospect reply.
